svg.title: tsrslint vs tsgolint 7.0.2003
svg.desc: Summed over 8 open-source projects · all 60 rules · 4-vCPU Linux machine. Lint time: tsrslint 37.3 s, tsgolint 169.4 s. Peak memory: tsrslint 11.5 GiB, tsgolint 45.0 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrslint 12.50 s, 2.43 GiB; tsgolint 49.32 s, 10.08 GiB. mui-docs: tsrslint 4.06 s, 1.56 GiB; tsgolint 32.86 s, 8.78 GiB. xstate: tsrslint 0.89 s, 488 MiB; tsgolint 2.81 s, 1.00 GiB. webpack: tsrslint 0.95 s, 451 MiB; tsgolint 3.51 s, 1.07 GiB. cal-diy: tsrslint 2.53 s, 1.25 GiB; tsgolint 11.23 s, 4.27 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrslint 5.29 s, 2.17 GiB; tsgolint 21.51 s, 6.93 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrslint 5.12 s, 1.81 GiB; tsgolint 22.14 s, 6.29 GiB. t3code-server: tsrslint 5.92 s, 1.37 GiB; tsgolint 26.06 s, 6.53 GiB. xstate and webpack are in the release build's PGO training set. Median of 3 interleaved runs. Machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-15 19:20 UTC; tsrslint commit e9e2a70fa37289f0e8abff7938ad85608393f72e (PGO dist build); stock tsgolint 7.0.2003 (npm @oxlint-tsgolint/linux-x64).
